name: Spire Sense
author: jerry
description: Overlay showing what your deck is made of and what it is doing. Counts how many cards fall into each category (frontloaded damage, scaling damage, AOE, frontloaded block, scaling block, acceleration), scores the deck out of 10, and measures your real damage, mitigation and draw per turn as the run goes. Hover any card to see its categories; open a card to reclassify it yourself. Press Insert to hide the panel.
